# Positive-control fixture for tests/test_identity_gate.py (Python).
#
# Two UNMARKED identity normalizations (a runtime SQL string with lower(%s) on line 7 and a
# str.lower() key on line 8) MUST be flagged; the arm_id_key calls and this comment's
# mention of .lower() must not be.
def upsert(cur, rid, keys):
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM synthetic.arm_overlay WHERE id_lower = lower(%s)", (rid,))
    return rid.lower() in keys or arm_id_key(rid) in keys


def fine(cur, rid):
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM synthetic.arm_overlay WHERE id_lower = synthetic.arm_id_key(%s)", (rid,))
